ns2:section.sectionText: Latin American Art Music This course is a survey of significant ideas and topics relevant to the study of Latin American art music. We will examine music’s significance in the colonial era; art music’s relevance to nation building and the formation of national and racial identities; art music and hemispheric and transnational politics; and musical practice and social change at the turn of the twenty-first century. Through these critical discussions, we will explore many pivotal moments, works, and composers in the history of Latin American art music.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MME:Music Education -UIUC or PHD:Musicology -UIUC.
